description: This file is a C source code file implementing a module for handling digital certificates, primarily for PKI, including creation, management, verification, and searching of certificates and related entities. It includes functions for managing certificate chains, trust stores, and cryptographic keys, and appears to be part of a larger PKI library or system.

classes.name: ALCERT_CONTEXT
classes.description: Main context structure representing a certificate management instance, holding lists of CAs and clients, and associated locks.

classes.name: PCA_ENTITY
classes.description: Represents a CA entity, containing certificate data and related metadata.

classes.name: PPKI_CLIENT_ENTITY

classes.description: Structure for identifying subjects by encoding, including name and attributes.
